'''Kiley''' (Japanese: '''カイリ''' ''Kairi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN063|On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!]]''. He is a pro surfer from [[Lilycove City]] and a friend of [[Chrysa]] who went to the same university as her.

Kiley and his {{p|Vaporeon}} participated in the adult division of the [[Marine Athletic Race]] and won. After getting in contact with Chrysa, he met up with {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Chloe]] when they arrived in Lilycove City. Kiley showed them around the course and watched the next day as they competed in the kids division of the Marine Athletic Race with their {{AP|Dracovish}}, {{TP|Goh|Dewgong}}, and {{TP|Chloe|Eevee}}.

When Chloe became trapped in a rock with Eevee and Dewgong having been attacked by a {{p|Huntail}}, Kiley came to her aid with Vaporeon and Huntail was soon defeated. Afterwards, Kiley gave Chloe a [[Water Stone]] so that she could evolve Eevee. Although Eevee did not want to evolve at that moment, Chloe decided to keep the Water Stone for potential future use.

He reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[JN105|Reuniting for the First Time!]]'' and ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''.

In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Kiley reappeared in a fantasy, alongside other Trainers Chloe and her Eevee met.

|desc={{p|Vaporeon}} is Kiley's only known Pokémon that has been his Pokémon since he was an {{p|Eevee}}. Kiley decided to evolve Eevee into Vaporeon after he showed a lot of interest in surfing. 

Vaporeon was first seen competing in the [[Marine Athletic Race]], where he won. When [[Chloe]] became trapped by a {{p|Huntail}}, Vaporeon was able to defeat it alongside {{TP|Chloe|Eevee}}.

He reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[JN105|Reuniting for the First Time!]]'' and ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''.

In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Vaporeon reappeared in a fantasy alongside Kiley.

Vaporeon is confirmed to be male by [[List of Pokémon with gender differences|gender differences]] as an Eevee.

Vaporeon's known moves are {{m|Swift}} and {{m|Hydro Pump}}.}}
